title: Safety Basics
tagline: OSHA-aligned foundations for any workplace — slips, lifts, knives, fires, first aid.
summary: A broad workplace-safety primer that satisfies the "we trained them on safety" requirement most operations need. Focused on real incidents that actually happen in restaurants, retail, and service: slips, burns, lifts, knife cuts.
outcomes: Recognize the most common workplace hazards in service environments
Perform safe lifts and avoid the most common back injuries
Respond correctly to a burn, cut, or fall
Know when to call 911, when to file, and when to clean and keep going
